single_test_failure.source: User-provided report of coordination-side self-review, 2026-11-02; not independently inspected candidate pixels
single_test_failure.coordinator_report: 统一指挥已明确授权一次设计测试图。本聊天的“最多1张、不自动重试”约束已遵守：已用归档辣椒炒肉原片制作1张候选。协调端自审结论：本张不通过，输出为1536×1024横版而非冻结方案4:5；主体变成炒锅/悬空炒勺，未保留原片餐盘构图与菜品真实身份，整体过暗、油亮过重，偏廉价戏剧化餐饮广告。标题大致可读，但不能弥补构图与真实感问题。
reported_failure_reasons: Wok/floating ladle overtook plated pepper pork as main visual subject
Original plate-based dish identity and accepted food realism not maintained
Excessively dark, excessive glossy/greasy rendering, cheap theatrical restaurant-ad effect
Roughly legible title insufficient to compensate failures
single_test_failure.note: User report establishes coordinator fail verdict and consumed budget; unknown candidate binary provenance is left unknown, not filled with invented values.

approved_original.name: 香辣青椒炒肉特写.png
approved_original.runtime_verified: YES: source PNG opened, bytes and SHA-256 computed and exact image visually inspected in this turn
approved_original.approved_scope: One source food image accepted for perceived authenticity and appetite; no complete poster approval.

non_generative_feasibility.question: Can the same archived original produce a complete 4:5 poster using only editable image placement, masking/background layers, and typography without another image generation?
non_generative_feasibility.aesthetic_verdict: UNKNOWN_NOT_DESIGN_PASS; split photo/text art direction may still be ordinary
non_generative_feasibility.commercial_final_verdict: NOT_READY; brand ownership/context, actual final editable file, and human aesthetic review missing
non_generative_feasibility.source_strategy: Use full original photograph at preserved aspect ratio; do NOT hallucinate missing right side plate or separate complete food object from frame.
non_generative_feasibility.typography_content: 仅用已知菜名「辣椒炒肉」，采用真实可编辑的中性中文印刷字形；未经核实不添加价格、品牌、原产地、现炒等商业宣称。
non_generative_feasibility.layout_readability: Photo remains dominant; two-line 2+2 Chinese dish-title in left column with disciplined hierarchy and neutral background sampled/tuned to food tones; not generic leaves, circles, gold badges or excessive marketing copy.
non_generative_feasibility.non_gen_tools: Figma or native vector editor: image as locked raster layer + neutral vector background + editable text, preserve actual source pixels and editable layout; export exact 4:5 canvas.
properties_possible_without_generation: Unchanged food textures, oil gloss, natural lighting
Clean surrounding neutral backgrounds, simple masks, aligned whitespace
properties_not_supported_without_new_pix: Adding actual wok and ladle while preserving source photo
Reconstructing complete right-hand rim of cut-off plate
Replacing the entire wood-table background around food with physically correct new contact shadows
Inferring a convincing 'just plated' action from a finished-food still image
non_generative_feasibility.scene_concept_update: The rejected '最后一勺，刚出锅' motion scene is NOT transferable to this non-generative original. Do not add wok, ladle, flame, or that time-specific claim to the original photo. The non-gen poster must focus on the existing dish, its actual food color and photographic relationships.
non_generative_feasibility.why_not_full_bleed: Filling 1200px width from 941px source yields ~2132px image height, requiring ~496 source-pixel-equivalent total vertical crop (~632 displayed pixels); this risks removing original context/plate. Prefer fit-inside at 1440px height.
independent_visual_observations: Dish fills much of the plate with a real rim but the right-hand plate is already cut by image boundary.
Food is concentrated central through lower right; photo contains window, wood tabletop and grey ceramic plate.
Full silhouette cutout is unsupported without manufacturing missing rim and shadow.
The photograph is sufficiently sharp and has acceptable existing user-approved food rendering.
non_generative_feasibility.design_risk: Simple vertical split text/photo poster may be technically usable yet not meet target's strong reference-level art direction. It is one feasible low-risk execution path, not an aesthetically proven mechanism.
evaluation_preconditions: Use original SHA to confirm same input
Save editable native frame and screenshot/export
Actual 1200×1500 raster export verifies aspect ratio 4:5
Manual review for food appetite and visual design
Keep photo source, raster original, and design/export lineage separate

decision_and_next.allowed_next_action: Return this recorded coordinator failure and non-generative feasibility to original coordinating mainline; if user authorizes non-gen layout work, compose the 1200×1500 editable poster using original raster without any new image API.
decision_and_next.forbidden_next_action: Any further image generation, image-edit generation, hidden variations, attempt reset, or automatic retry without new coordinator approval.
